sources.title: Krea 2 AI - Free Real-Time AI Image & Video Generator
sources.snippet: Krea 2 AI is a revolutionary, pro-grade free real-time AI image generator designed to change how artists, designers, and marketers brainstorm ideas. Powered by bleeding-edge latent consistency models, Krea 2 AI updates the canvas dynamically as you type or sketch, providing zero-latency creative feedback.
